Lines: 1.Player put their own instruments into the operation interface.
2.Players can select the instrument which he wants to fuse in the main interface box.
3.Click the "fusion" button, the system will transfer the basic attribute of the instrument which need to be fused to the instrument player provide to fuse by a definite proportion.

4.If the instrument which need to be fused contains special effect,this effect can be transferred to the instrument player wants to fuse only when the attribute which is transferred reach a certain value.
5.After the fusion, the system will deduct a certain amount of gold equipment upgrade card  , and provide you the preview of the instrument which is after the fusion.
6.After the completion of the fusion, players can choose "Save" or "Cancel"
7.Click the "Save" button, the preview instrument becomes entity instrument, players can put it to the package.
8.when the instrument which has floating attribute or floating effect is fused again and click the save button, all the floating attribute or floating effect will be cover.
